decisions.reason: Replacing INA219 with INA3221 does not change the defined power sources, diode OR-ing method, or source-selection behavior.
The current-monitor component selection does not affect the addressable LEDs' 5V supply, switching, or logic-level handling.
The necessary impact is already fully represented by the existing message-352 MODIFY that changes monitor_ic from INA219 to INA3221.
The INA3221 selection does not change the switched 5V boost supply's enable control, output rating, or powered loads.
The main-board current-monitor substitution does not change the battery connector, pinout, voltage range, or AXP2101 connection.
Changing the current-monitor IC does not entail any change to the main-board connector inventory or connector counts.
The current-monitor component choice is independent of panel controls, touch inputs, buttons, reset wiring, and their GPIO mappings.
Selecting INA3221 does not necessarily change the established I2C series-resistor values, placement, purpose, or population policy.
The component substitution does not itself establish a change to the general requirement for local decoupling; any component-specific capacitor changes would require separate evidence.
The INA3221 selection does not entail a change to any established ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The monitor-IC replacement does not change the specified I2C clock speed, pull-ups, cable length, or series-resistor configuration.
Replacing the current monitor leaves the board-chain order, interboard rails, connectors, and forwarding behavior unchanged.
